preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of special offers is between 0 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number written on each vertex is between 1 and 10^12, inclusive.
The vertices involved in each special offer are valid indices of vertices in the graph.
The cost of each special offer is between 1 and 10^12, inclusive.
There are no self-loops in the special offers.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the minimum number of coins to make the graph connected.
